descriptionHtml: IEEE electronic design competiton is organized by IEEE Sri Lanka section. Teams with 3 members can participate the competition and atleast one member must be an IEEE student member. An electronic circuit that satisfies given specifications should be designed and implemented within the given time. This competition is organized in 5 Universities in Sri Lanka such that the competition occurs parallelly at the same time.
